verses.original: וּבֶן־ הֲדַ֣ד מֶֽלֶךְ־ אֲרָ֗ם קָבַץ֙ אֶת־ כָּל־ חֵיל֔וֹ אִתּ֖וֹ וּשְׁלֹשִׁ֨ים וּשְׁנַ֥יִם מֶ֛לֶךְ וְס֣וּס וָרָ֑כֶב וַיַּ֗עַל וַיָּ֙צַר֙ עַל־ שֹׁ֣מְר֔וֹן וַיִּלָּ֖חֶם בָּֽהּ׃
verses.transliteration: ū·ḇen- hă·ḏaḏ me·leḵ- ’ă·rām qā·ḇaṣ ’eṯ- kāl- ḥê·lōw ’it·tōw ū·šə·lō·šîm ū·šə·na·yim me·leḵ wə·sūs wā·rā·ḵeḇ way·ya·‘al way·yā·ṣar ‘al- šō·mə·rō·wn way·yil·lā·ḥem bāh
verses.literal: vvv Now Ben-hadad king of Aram assembled - his entire army Accompanied by thirty-two . . . kings with their horses and chariots he marched up besieged . . . Samaria and waged war against it

verses.original: וַיִּשְׁלַ֧ח מַלְאָכִ֛ים הָעִֽירָה׃ אֶל־ אַחְאָ֥ב מֶֽלֶךְ־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל
verses.transliteration: way·yiš·laḥ mal·’ā·ḵîm hā·‘î·rāh ’el- ’aḥ·’āḇ me·leḵ- yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: Then he sent messengers into the city to Ahab king of Israel

verses.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר ל֗וֹ כֹּ֚ה בֶּן־ הֲדַ֔ד אָמַ֣ר כַּסְפְּךָ֥ וּֽזְהָבְךָ֖ ה֑וּא לִֽי־ הַטּוֹבִ֖ים וְנָשֶׁ֧יךָ וּבָנֶ֛יךָ הֵֽם׃ לִי־
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer lōw kōh ben- hă·ḏaḏ ’ā·mar kas·pə·ḵā ū·zə·hā·ḇə·ḵā hū lî- haṭ·ṭō·w·ḇîm wə·nā·še·ḵā ū·ḇā·ne·ḵā hêm lî-
verses.literal: saying This is what vvv Ben-hadad says Your silver and gold are mine and your best wives and children are mine

verses.original: מֶֽלֶךְ־ יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ וַיֹּ֔אמֶר וַיַּ֤עַן כִּדְבָרְךָ֖ אֲדֹנִ֣י הַמֶּ֑לֶךְ לְךָ֥ אֲנִ֖י וְכָל־ אֲשֶׁר־ לִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: me·leḵ- yiś·rā·’êl way·yō·mer way·ya·‘an kiḏ·ḇā·rə·ḵā ’ă·ḏō·nî ham·me·leḵ lə·ḵā ’ă·nî wə·ḵāl ’ă·šer- lî
verses.literal: And the king of Israel . . . replied Just as you say my lord the king vvv I am yours along with all that I have

verses.original: הַמַּלְאָכִ֔ים וַיָּשֻׁ֙בוּ֙ וַיֹּ֣אמְר֔וּ כֹּֽה־ הֲדַ֖ד אָמַ֥ר בֶּן־ שָׁלַ֤חְתִּי אֵלֶ֙יךָ֙ לֵאמֹ֔ר לֵאמֹ֑ר כִּֽי־ תִתֵּֽן׃ לִ֥י כַּסְפְּךָ֧ וּזְהָבְךָ֛ וְנָשֶׁ֥יךָ וּבָנֶ֖יךָ
verses.transliteration: ham·mal·’ā·ḵîm way·yā·šu·ḇū way·yō·mə·rū kōh- hă·ḏaḏ ’ā·mar ben- šā·laḥ·tî ’ê·le·ḵā lê·mōr lê·mōr kî- ṯit·tên lî kas·pə·ḵā ū·zə·hā·ḇə·ḵā wə·nā·še·ḵā ū·ḇā·ne·ḵā
verses.literal: The messengers came back and said This is what Ben-hadad says I have sent to you . . . to demand . . . - - your silver your gold your wives and your children

verses.original: כִּ֣י׀ אִם־ כָּעֵ֣ת מָחָ֗ר אֶשְׁלַ֤ח אֶת־ עֲבָדַי֙ אֵלֶ֔יךָ וְחִפְּשׂוּ֙ אֶת־ בֵּ֣יתְךָ֔ וְאֵ֖ת בָּתֵּ֣י עֲבָדֶ֑יךָ יָשִׂ֥ימוּ בְיָדָ֖ם וְלָקָֽחוּ׃ כָּל־ וְהָיָה֙ מַחְמַ֣ד עֵינֶ֔יךָ
verses.transliteration: kî ’im- kā·‘êṯ mā·ḥār ’eš·laḥ ’eṯ- ‘ă·ḇā·ḏay ’ê·le·ḵā wə·ḥip·pə·śū ’eṯ- bê·ṯə·ḵā wə·’êṯ bāt·tê ‘ă·ḇā·ḏe·ḵā yā·śî·mū ḇə·yā·ḏām wə·lā·qā·ḥū kāl- wə·hā·yāh maḥ·maḏ ‘ê·ne·ḵā
verses.literal: But about this time tomorrow I will send - my servants to search - your palace and the houses of your servants They will seize . . . and carry away all that is precious to you

verses.original: מֶֽלֶךְ־ יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ וַיִּקְרָ֤א לְכָל־ זִקְנֵ֣י הָאָ֔רֶץ וַיֹּ֙אמֶר֙ נָ֣א דְּעֽוּ־ וּרְא֔וּ כִּ֥י זֶ֣ה מְבַקֵּ֑שׁ רָעָ֖ה כִּֽי־ שָׁלַ֨ח אֵלַ֜י לְנָשַׁ֤י וּלְבָנַי֙ וּלְכַסְפִּ֣י וְלִזְהָבִ֔י וְלֹ֥א מָנַ֖עְתִּי מִמֶּֽנּוּ׃
verses.transliteration: me·leḵ- yiś·rā·’êl way·yiq·rā lə·ḵāl ziq·nê hā·’ā·reṣ way·yō·mer nā də·‘ū- ū·rə·’ū kî zeh mə·ḇaq·qêš rā·‘āh kî- šā·laḥ ’ê·lay lə·nā·šay ū·lə·ḇā·nay ū·lə·ḵas·pî wə·liz·hā·ḇî wə·lō mā·na‘·tî mim·men·nū
verses.literal: Then the king of Israel summoned all the elders of the land and said Please take note and see that this [man] is looking for trouble for when he demanded . . . my wives my children my silver and my gold I did not deny him

verses.original: הַזְּקֵנִ֖ים וְכָל־ הָעָ֑ם כָּל־ וַיֹּאמְר֥וּ אֵלָ֛יו אַל־ תִּשְׁמַ֖ע וְל֥וֹא תֹאבֶֽה׃
verses.transliteration: haz·zə·qê·nîm wə·ḵāl hā·‘ām kāl- way·yō·mə·rū ’ê·lāw ’al- tiš·ma‘ wə·lō·w ṯō·ḇeh
verses.literal: And the elders and the people all said - Do not listen to him or consent to his terms

verses.original: וַיֹּ֜אמֶר לְמַלְאֲכֵ֣י בֶן־ הֲדַ֗ד אִמְר֞וּ לַֽאדֹנִ֤י הַמֶּ֙לֶךְ֙ כֹּל֩ אֲשֶׁר־ שָׁלַ֨חְתָּ אֶל־ עַבְדְּךָ֤ בָרִֽאשֹׁנָה֙ אֶעֱשֶׂ֔ה הַזֶּ֔ה וְהַדָּבָ֣ר לֹ֥א אוּכַ֖ל לַעֲשׂ֑וֹת הַמַּלְאָכִ֔ים וַיֵּֽלְכוּ֙ דָּבָֽר׃ וַיְשִׁבֻ֖הוּ
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer lə·mal·’ă·ḵê ḇen- hă·ḏaḏ ’im·rū la·ḏō·nî ham·me·leḵ kōl ’ă·šer- šā·laḥ·tā ’el- ‘aḇ·də·ḵā ḇā·ri·šō·nāh ’e·‘ĕ·śeh haz·zeh wə·had·dā·ḇār lō ’ū·ḵal la·‘ă·śō·wṯ ham·mal·’ā·ḵîm way·yê·lə·ḵū dā·ḇār way·ši·ḇu·hū
verses.literal: So [Ahab] answered the messengers vvv of Ben-hadad Tell my lord the king All that you demanded of your servant the first time I will do but this thing I cannot . . . do So the messengers departed and relayed the message to [Ben-hadad] . . .

verses.original: הֲדַ֔ד וַיִּשְׁלַ֤ח בֶּן־ וַיֹּ֕אמֶר אֵלָיו֙ אֱלֹהִ֖ים כֹּֽה־ יַעֲשׂ֥וּן לִ֛י וְכֹ֣ה יוֹסִ֑פוּ אִם־ עֲפַ֣ר יִשְׂפֹּק֙ שֹׁמְר֔וֹן לְכָל־ הָעָ֖ם אֲשֶׁ֥ר בְּרַגְלָֽי׃ לִשְׁעָלִ֕ים
verses.transliteration: hă·ḏaḏ way·yiš·laḥ ben- way·yō·mer ’ê·lāw ’ĕ·lō·hîm kōh- ya·‘ă·śūn lî wə·ḵōh yō·w·si·p̄ū ’im- ‘ă·p̄ar yiś·pōq šō·mə·rō·wn lə·ḵāl hā·‘ām ’ă·šer bə·raḡ·lāy liš·‘ā·lîm
verses.literal: Then Ben-hadad sent another message to [Ahab] May the gods deal with me and ever so severely if [enough] dust remains of Samaria for each of my men - - [to have] a handful

verses.original: מֶֽלֶךְ־ יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ וַיֹּ֣אמֶר וַיַּ֤עַן דַּבְּר֔וּ חֹגֵ֖ר אַל־ יִתְהַלֵּ֥ל כִּמְפַתֵּֽחַ׃
verses.transliteration: me·leḵ- yiś·rā·’êl way·yō·mer way·ya·‘an dab·bə·rū ḥō·ḡêr ’al- yiṯ·hal·lêl kim·p̄at·tê·aḥ
verses.literal: And the king of Israel . . . replied Tell him The one putting on [his armor] should not boast like one taking [it off]

verses.original: וַיְהִ֗י כִּשְׁמֹ֙עַ֙ אֶת־ הַזֶּ֔ה הַדָּבָ֣ר וְה֥וּא וְהַמְּלָכִ֖ים שֹׁתֶ֛ה ה֥וּא בַּסֻּכּ֑וֹת וַיֹּ֤אמֶר אֶל־ עֲבָדָיו֙ שִׂ֔ימוּ וַיָּשִׂ֖ימוּ עַל־ הָעִֽיר׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî kiš·mō·a‘ ’eṯ- haz·zeh had·dā·ḇār wə·hū wə·ham·mə·lā·ḵîm šō·ṯeh hū bas·suk·kō·wṯ way·yō·mer ’el- ‘ă·ḇā·ḏāw śî·mū way·yā·śî·mū ‘al- hā·‘îr
verses.literal: - Ben-hadad received - this message while he and the kings were drinking . . . in their tents and he said to his servants Take your positions So they stationed themselves against the city

verses.original: וְהִנֵּ֣ה׀ אֶחָ֗ד נָבִ֣יא נִגַּשׁ֮ אֶל־ אַחְאָ֣ב מֶֽלֶךְ־ יִשְׂרָאֵל֒ וַיֹּ֗אמֶר כֹּ֚ה יְהוָ֔ה אָמַ֣ר הְֽרָאִ֔יתָ אֵ֛ת הַזֶּ֑ה כָּל־ הַגָּד֖וֹל הֶהָמ֥וֹן הִנְנִ֨י נֹתְנ֤וֹ בְיָֽדְךָ֙ הַיּ֔וֹם וְיָדַעְתָּ֖ כִּֽי־ אֲנִ֥י יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hin·nêh ’e·ḥāḏ nā·ḇî nig·gaš ’el- ’aḥ·’āḇ me·leḵ- yiś·rā·’êl way·yō·mer kōh Yah·weh ’ā·mar hə·rā·’î·ṯā ’êṯ haz·zeh kāl- hag·gā·ḏō·wl he·hā·mō·wn hin·nî nō·ṯə·nōw ḇə·yā·ḏə·ḵā hay·yō·wm wə·yā·ḏa‘·tā kî- ’ă·nî Yah·weh
verses.literal: Meanwhile a prophet approached . . . Ahab king of Israel and declared This is what the LORD says Do you see - this entire great army Behold I will deliver it into your hand this very day and you will know that I am the LORD

verses.original: בְּמִ֔י אַחְאָב֙ וַיֹּ֤אמֶר וַיֹּ֙אמֶר֙ כֹּֽה־ יְהוָ֔ה אָמַ֣ר בְּנַעֲרֵ֖י הַמְּדִינ֑וֹת שָׂרֵ֣י מִֽי־ יֶאְסֹ֥ר הַמִּלְחָמָ֖ה וַיֹּ֛אמֶר אָֽתָּה׃ וַיֹּ֥אמֶר
verses.transliteration: bə·mî ’aḥ·’āḇ way·yō·mer way·yō·mer kōh- Yah·weh ’ā·mar bə·na·‘ă·rê ham·mə·ḏî·nō·wṯ śā·rê mî- ye’·sōr ham·mil·ḥā·māh way·yō·mer ’āt·tāh way·yō·mer
verses.literal: By whom Ahab asked And the prophet replied This is what the LORD says By the young officers of the district governors Who will start the battle asked [Ahab] You [will] answered the prophet

verses.original: וַיִּפְקֹ֗ד אֶֽת־ נַעֲרֵי֙ הַמְּדִינ֔וֹת שָׂרֵ֣י וַיִּהְי֕וּ מָאתַ֖יִם שְׁנַ֣יִם וּשְׁלֹשִׁ֑ים וְאַחֲרֵיהֶ֗ם פָּקַ֧ד אֶת־ כָּל־ בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל הָעָ֛ם שִׁבְעַ֥ת אֲלָפִֽים׃ כָּל־
verses.transliteration: way·yip̄·qōḏ ’eṯ- na·‘ă·rê ham·mə·ḏî·nō·wṯ śā·rê way·yih·yū mā·ṯa·yim šə·na·yim ū·šə·lō·šîm wə·’a·ḥă·rê·hem pā·qaḏ ’eṯ- kāl- bə·nê yiś·rā·’êl hā·‘ām šiḇ·‘aṯ ’ă·lā·p̄îm kāl-
verses.literal: So Ahab assembled - the young officers of the district governors and there were 232 men . . . . . . And after them he assembled - [the rest of] the Israelite . . . troops 7,000 {} . . . in all

verses.original: וַיֵּצְא֖וּ בַּֽצָּהֳרָ֑יִם וּבֶן־ הֲדַד֩ שְׁלֹשִֽׁים־ וּשְׁנַ֥יִם מֶ֖לֶךְ וְהַמְּלָכִ֛ים עֹזֵ֥ר אֹתֽוֹ׃ בַּסֻּכּ֗וֹת ה֧וּא שֹׁתֶ֨ה שִׁכּ֜וֹר
verses.transliteration: way·yê·ṣə·’ū baṣ·ṣā·ho·rā·yim ū·ḇen- hă·ḏaḏ šə·lō·šîm- ū·šə·na·yim me·leḵ wə·ham·mə·lā·ḵîm ‘ō·zêr ’ō·ṯōw bas·suk·kō·wṯ hū šō·ṯeh šik·kō·wr
verses.literal: They marched out at noon vvv while Ben-hadad and the 32 . . . . . . kings allied with him were in their tents . . . getting drunk

verses.original: נַעֲרֵ֛י הַמְּדִינ֖וֹת שָׂרֵ֥י וַיֵּצְא֗וּ בָּרִֽאשֹׁנָ֑ה הֲדַ֗ד וַיִּשְׁלַ֣ח בֶּן־ וַיַּגִּ֤ידוּ לוֹ֙ לֵאמֹ֔ר אֲנָשִׁ֕ים יָצְא֖וּ מִשֹּׁמְרֽוֹן׃
verses.transliteration: na·‘ă·rê ham·mə·ḏî·nō·wṯ śā·rê way·yê·ṣə·’ū bā·ri·šō·nāh hă·ḏaḏ way·yiš·laḥ ben- way·yag·gî·ḏū lōw lê·mōr ’ă·nā·šîm yā·ṣə·’ū miš·šō·mə·rō·wn
verses.literal: And the young officers of the district governors marched out first . . . Now Ben-hadad had sent out scouts who reported to him Men are marching out of Samaria

verses.original: אִם־ יָצָ֖אוּ לְשָׁל֥וֹם וַיֹּ֛אמֶר תִּפְשׂ֣וּם חַיִּ֑ים וְאִ֧ם יָצָ֖אוּ לְמִלְחָמָ֛ה תִּפְשֽׂוּם׃ חַיִּ֥ים
verses.transliteration: ’im- yā·ṣā·’ū lə·šā·lō·wm way·yō·mer tip̄·śūm ḥay·yîm wə·’im yā·ṣā·’ū lə·mil·ḥā·māh tip̄·śūm ḥay·yîm
verses.literal: If they have marched out in peace he said take them alive Even if they have marched out for war take them alive

verses.original: וְאֵ֙לֶּה֙ נַעֲרֵ֖י הַמְּדִינ֑וֹת שָׂרֵ֣י יָצְא֣וּ מִן־ הָעִ֔יר וְהַחַ֖יִל אֲשֶׁ֥ר אַחֲרֵיהֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’êl·leh na·‘ă·rê ham·mə·ḏî·nō·wṯ śā·rê yā·ṣə·’ū min- hā·‘îr wə·ha·ḥa·yil ’ă·šer ’a·ḥă·rê·hem
verses.literal: Meanwhile, these young officers of the district governors marched out of the city with the army - behind them

verses.original: אִ֣ישׁ וַיַּכּוּ֙ אִישׁ֔וֹ אֲרָ֔ם וַיָּנֻ֣סוּ יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וַֽיִּרְדְּפֵ֖ם הֲדַד֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ אֲרָ֔ם וַיִּמָּלֵ֗ט בֶּן־ עַל־ ס֖וּס וּפָרָשִֽׁים׃
verses.transliteration: ’îš way·yak·kū ’î·šōw ’ă·rām way·yā·nu·sū yiś·rā·’êl way·yir·də·p̄êm hă·ḏaḏ me·leḵ ’ă·rām way·yim·mā·lêṭ ben- ‘al- sūs ū·p̄ā·rā·šîm
verses.literal: and each one struck down his opponent So the Arameans fled with the Israelites in pursuit But Ben-hadad king of Aram escaped on horseback with the cavalry

verses.original: מֶ֣לֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וַיֵּצֵא֙ וַיַּ֥ךְ אֶת־ הַסּ֖וּס וְאֶת־ הָרָ֑כֶב וְהִכָּ֥ה גְדוֹלָֽה׃ מַכָּ֥ה בַאֲרָ֖ם
verses.transliteration: me·leḵ yiś·rā·’êl way·yê·ṣê way·yaḵ ’eṯ- has·sūs wə·’eṯ- hā·rā·ḵeḇ wə·hik·kāh ḡə·ḏō·w·lāh mak·kāh ḇa·’ă·rām
verses.literal: Then the king of Israel marched out and attacked - the horses - and chariots inflicting a great slaughter on the Arameans

verses.original: הַנָּבִיא֙ אֶל־ וַיִּגַּ֤שׁ מֶ֣לֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וַיֹּ֤אמֶר לוֹ֙ לֵ֣ךְ הִתְחַזַּ֔ק וְדַ֥ע וּרְאֵ֖ה אֵ֣ת אֲשֶֽׁר־ תַּעֲשֶׂ֑ה כִּ֚י לִתְשׁוּבַ֣ת הַשָּׁנָ֔ה מֶ֥לֶךְ אֲרָ֖ם עֹלֶ֥ה עָלֶֽיךָ׃ס
verses.transliteration: han·nā·ḇî ’el- way·yig·gaš me·leḵ yiś·rā·’êl way·yō·mer lōw lêḵ hiṯ·ḥaz·zaq wə·ḏa‘ ū·rə·’êh ’êṯ ’ă·šer- ta·‘ă·śeh kî liṯ·šū·ḇaṯ haš·šā·nāh me·leḵ ’ă·rām ‘ō·leh ‘ā·le·ḵā
verses.literal: Afterward, the prophet . . . approached the king of Israel and said Go and strengthen [your position] and take note . . . - what you must do for in the spring . . . the king of Aram will come up against you

verses.original: וְעַבְדֵ֨י מֶֽלֶךְ־ אֲרָ֜ם אָמְר֣וּ אֵלָ֗יו אֱלֹ֣הֵיהֶ֔ם אֱלֹהֵ֤י הָרִים֙ עַל־ כֵּ֖ן חָזְק֣וּ מִמֶּ֑נּוּ וְאוּלָ֗ם נִלָּחֵ֤ם אִתָּם֙ בַּמִּישׁ֔וֹר אִם־ לֹ֥א נֶחֱזַ֖ק מֵהֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·‘aḇ·ḏê me·leḵ- ’ă·rām ’ā·mə·rū ’ê·lāw ’ĕ·lō·hê·hem ’ĕ·lō·hê hā·rîm ‘al- kên ḥā·zə·qū mim·men·nū wə·’ū·lām nil·lā·ḥêm ’it·tām bam·mî·šō·wr ’im- lō ne·ḥĕ·zaq mê·hem
verses.literal: Meanwhile, the servants of the king of Aram said to him Their gods [are] gods of the hills That is why . . . they prevailed over us Instead we should fight them on the plains surely then we will prevail

verses.original: וְאֶת־ הַדָּבָ֥ר עֲשֵׂ֑ה הַזֶּ֖ה הָסֵ֤ר אִ֣ישׁ הַמְּלָכִים֙ מִמְּקֹמ֔וֹ וְשִׂ֥ים תַּחְתֵּיהֶֽם׃ פַּח֖וֹת
verses.transliteration: wə·’eṯ- had·dā·ḇār ‘ă·śêh haz·zeh hā·sêr ’îš ham·mə·lā·ḵîm mim·mə·qō·mōw wə·śîm taḥ·tê·hem pa·ḥō·wṯ
verses.literal: So - do this Dismiss all the kings from their positions and replace them . . . with other officers

verses.original: וְאַתָּ֣ה תִֽמְנֶה־ לְךָ֣׀ חַ֡יִל כַּחַיִל֩ הַנֹּפֵ֨ל מֵאוֹתָ֜ךְ וְס֣וּס כַּסּ֣וּס׀ וְרֶ֣כֶב כָּרֶ֗כֶב וְנִֽלָּחֲמָ֤ה אוֹתָם֙ בַּמִּישׁ֔וֹר אִם־ לֹ֥א נֶחֱזַ֖ק מֵהֶ֑ם וַיִּשְׁמַ֥ע לְקֹלָ֖ם וַיַּ֥עַשׂ כֵּֽן׃פ
verses.transliteration: wə·’at·tāh ṯim·neh- lə·ḵā ḥa·yil ka·ḥa·yil han·nō·p̄êl mê·’ō·w·ṯāḵ wə·sūs kas·sūs wə·re·ḵeḇ kā·re·ḵeḇ wə·nil·lā·ḥă·māh ’ō·w·ṯām bam·mî·šō·wr ’im- lō ne·ḥĕ·zaq mê·hem way·yiš·ma‘ lə·qō·lām way·ya·‘aś kên
verses.literal: And you must raise an army like the [one] you have lost - horse for horse and chariot for chariot so we can fight [the Israelites] on the plain where we will surely . . . prevail . . . And [the king] approved their plan and acted accordingly

verses.original: וַֽיְהִי֙ לִתְשׁוּבַ֣ת הַשָּׁנָ֔ה הֲדַ֖ד אֶת־ וַיִּפְקֹ֥ד בֶּן־ אֲרָ֑ם וַיַּ֣עַל אֲפֵ֔קָה לַמִּלְחָמָ֖ה עִם־ יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî liṯ·šū·ḇaṯ haš·šā·nāh hă·ḏaḏ ’eṯ- way·yip̄·qōḏ ben- ’ă·rām way·ya·‘al ’ă·p̄ê·qāh lam·mil·ḥā·māh ‘im- yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: - In the spring . . . Ben-hadad - mobilized vvv the Arameans and went up to Aphek to fight against Israel

verses.original: וּבְנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל הָתְפָּקְדוּ֙ וְכָלְכְּל֔וּ וַיֵּלְכ֖וּ לִקְרָאתָ֑ם בְנֵֽי־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֜ל וַיַּחֲנ֨וּ נֶגְדָּ֗ם כִּשְׁנֵי֙ חֲשִׂפֵ֣י עִזִּ֔ים וַאֲרָ֖ם מִלְא֥וּ אֶת־ הָאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.transliteration: ū·ḇə·nê yiś·rā·’êl hā·ṯə·pā·qə·ḏū wə·ḵā·lə·kə·lū way·yê·lə·ḵū liq·rā·ṯām ḇə·nê- yiś·rā·’êl way·ya·ḥă·nū neḡ·dām kiš·nê ḥă·śi·p̄ê ‘iz·zîm wa·’ă·rām mil·’ū ’eṯ- hā·’ā·reṣ
verses.literal: The Israelites . . . also mobilized gathered supplies and marched out to meet them The Israelites . . . camped before them like two small flocks of goats while the Arameans covered - the countryside

verses.original: אִ֣ישׁ הָאֱלֹהִ֗ים וַיִּגַּ֞שׁ מֶ֣לֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵל֒ וַיֹּאמֶר֮ אֶל־ וַיֹּ֜אמֶר כֹּֽה־ יְהוָ֗ה אָמַ֣ר יַ֠עַן אֲשֶׁ֨ר אֲרָם֙ אָמְר֤וּ יְהוָ֔ה אֱלֹהֵ֤י הָרִים֙ וְלֹֽא־ אֱלֹהֵ֥י עֲמָקִ֖ים ה֑וּא וְ֠נָתַתִּי כָּל־ הַזֶּה֙ הַגָּ֤דוֹל הֶהָמ֨וֹן אֶת־ בְּיָדֶ֔ךָ וִֽידַעְתֶּ֖ם כִּֽי־ אֲנִ֥י יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ’îš hā·’ĕ·lō·hîm way·yig·gaš me·leḵ yiś·rā·’êl way·yō·mer ’el- way·yō·mer kōh- Yah·weh ’ā·mar ya·‘an ’ă·šer ’ă·rām ’ā·mə·rū Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê hā·rîm wə·lō- ’ĕ·lō·hê ‘ă·mā·qîm hū wə·nā·ṯat·tî kāl- haz·zeh hag·gā·ḏō·wl he·hā·mō·wn ’eṯ- bə·yā·ḏe·ḵā wî·ḏa‘·tem kî- ’ă·nî Yah·weh
verses.literal: Then the man of God approached the king of Israel and said - This is what the LORD says Because - the Arameans have said that the LORD is a god of the hills and not - of the valleys . . . I will deliver all this great army - into your hand Then you will know that I am the LORD

verses.original: שִׁבְעַ֣ת יָמִ֑ים וַֽיַּחֲנ֧וּ אֵ֦לֶּה נֹ֥כַח אֵ֖לֶּה וַיְהִ֣י׀ הַשְּׁבִיעִ֗י בַּיּ֣וֹם הַמִּלְחָמָ֔ה וַתִּקְרַב֙ בְנֵֽי־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֧ל אֶת־ וַיַּכּ֨וּ אֲרָ֛ם מֵאָה־ אֶ֥לֶף רַגְלִ֖י אֶחָֽד׃ בְּי֥וֹם
verses.transliteration: šiḇ·‘aṯ yā·mîm way·ya·ḥă·nū ’êl·leh nō·ḵaḥ ’êl·leh way·hî haš·šə·ḇî·‘î bay·yō·wm ham·mil·ḥā·māh wat·tiq·raḇ ḇə·nê- yiś·rā·’êl ’eṯ- way·yak·kū ’ă·rām mê·’āh- ’e·lep̄ raḡ·lî ’e·ḥāḏ bə·yō·wm
verses.literal: For seven days [the armies] camped opposite each other . . . . . . and on the seventh day the battle ensued and the Israelites . . . - struck down the Arameans a hundred thousand foot soldiers in one day

verses.original: הַנּוֹתָרִ֥ים׀ וַיָּנֻ֨סוּ אֶל־ הָעִיר֒ אֲפֵקָה֮ הַחוֹמָ֔ה וַתִּפֹּל֙ עַל־ עֶשְׂרִ֨ים וְשִׁבְעָ֥ה אֶ֛לֶף הַנּוֹתָרִ֑ים אִ֖ישׁ וּבֶן־ הֲדַ֣ד נָ֔ס הָעִ֖יר וַיָּבֹ֥א אֶל־ חֶ֥דֶר בְּחָֽדֶר׃ס
verses.transliteration: han·nō·w·ṯā·rîm way·yā·nu·sū ’el- hā·‘îr ’ă·p̄ê·qāh ha·ḥō·w·māh wat·tip·pōl ‘al- ‘eś·rîm wə·šiḇ·‘āh ’e·lep̄ han·nō·w·ṯā·rîm ’îš ū·ḇen- hă·ḏaḏ nās hā·‘îr way·yā·ḇō ’el- ḥe·ḏer bə·ḥā·ḏer
verses.literal: The rest of them fled into the city of Aphek where the wall fell on twenty-seven . . . thousand of the remaining men vvv Ben-hadad also fled to the city and hid in an inner room . . .

verses.original: עֲבָדָיו֒ וַיֹּאמְר֣וּ אֵלָיו֮ הִנֵּֽה־ נָ֣א שָׁמַ֔עְנוּ כִּ֗י מַלְכֵי֙ בֵּ֣ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל כִּֽי־ חֶ֖סֶד הֵ֑ם מַלְכֵ֥י וְנֵצֵא֙ אֶל־ מֶ֣לֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל נָשִׂ֣ימָה נָּא֩ שַׂקִּ֨ים בְּמָתְנֵ֜ינוּ וַחֲבָלִ֣ים בְּרֹאשֵׁ֗נוּ אוּלַ֖י יְחַיֶּ֥ה אֶת־ נַפְשֶֽׁךָ׃
verses.transliteration: ‘ă·ḇā·ḏāw way·yō·mə·rū ’ê·lāw hin·nêh- nā šā·ma‘·nū kî mal·ḵê bêṯ yiś·rā·’êl kî- ḥe·seḏ hêm mal·ḵê wə·nê·ṣê ’el- me·leḵ yiś·rā·’êl nā·śî·māh nā śaq·qîm bə·mā·ṯə·nê·nū wa·ḥă·ḇā·lîm bə·rō·šê·nū ’ū·lay yə·ḥay·yeh ’eṯ- nap̄·še·ḵā
verses.literal: Then the servants of [Ben-hadad] said to him Look now we have heard that the kings of the house of Israel . . . are merciful . . . - Let us go out to the king of Israel [with] . . . sackcloth around our waists and ropes around our heads Perhaps he will spare - your life

verses.original: וַיַּחְגְּרוּ֩ שַׂקִּ֨ים בְּמָתְנֵיהֶ֜ם וַחֲבָלִ֣ים בְּרָאשֵׁיהֶ֗ם וַיָּבֹ֙אוּ֙ אֶל־ מֶ֣לֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וַיֹּ֣אמְר֔וּ עַבְדְּךָ֧ בֶן־ הֲדַ֛ד אָמַ֖ר נָ֣א תְּחִֽי־ נַפְשִׁ֑י וַיֹּ֛אמֶר הַעוֹדֶ֥נּוּ חַ֖י הֽוּא׃ אָחִ֥י
verses.transliteration: way·yaḥ·gə·rū śaq·qîm bə·mā·ṯə·nê·hem wa·ḥă·ḇā·lîm bə·rā·šê·hem way·yā·ḇō·’ū ’el- me·leḵ yiś·rā·’êl way·yō·mə·rū ‘aḇ·də·ḵā ḇen- hă·ḏaḏ ’ā·mar nā tə·ḥî- nap̄·šî way·yō·mer ha·‘ō·w·ḏen·nū ḥay hū ’ā·ḥî
verses.literal: So [with] sackcloth around their waists and ropes around their heads they went to the king of Israel and said Your servant vvv Ben-hadad says Please spare my life And [the king] answered Is he still alive He is my brother

verses.original: וְהָאֲנָשִׁים֩ יְנַחֲשׁ֨וּ וַֽיְמַהֲר֜וּ וַיַּחְלְט֣וּ הֲמִמֶּ֗נּוּ וַיֹּֽאמְרוּ֙ אָחִ֣יךָ בֶן־ הֲדַ֔ד בֹּ֣אוּ קָחֻ֑הוּ וַיֹּ֖אמֶר בֶּן־ הֲדַ֔ד וַיֵּצֵ֤א אֵלָיו֙ וַֽיַּעֲלֵ֖הוּ עַל־ הַמֶּרְכָּבָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hā·’ă·nā·šîm yə·na·ḥă·šū way·ma·hă·rū way·yaḥ·lə·ṭū hă·mim·men·nū way·yō·mə·rū ’ā·ḥî·ḵā ḇen- hă·ḏaḏ bō·’ū qā·ḥu·hū way·yō·mer ben- hă·ḏaḏ way·yê·ṣê ’ê·lāw way·ya·‘ă·lê·hū ‘al- ham·mer·kā·ḇāh
verses.literal: Now the men were looking for a sign of hope and they quickly grasped [at this word] . . . and replied Yes, your brother vvv Ben-hadad Go and get him said [the king] vvv Then Ben-hadad came out - and Ahab had him come up into his chariot

verses.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֵלָ֡יו אָשִׁ֗יב הֶעָרִ֣ים אֲשֶׁר־ אָבִי֩ לָֽקַח־ מֵאֵ֨ת אָבִ֜יךָ תָּשִׂ֨ים לְךָ֤ וְ֠חוּצוֹת בְדַמֶּ֙שֶׂק֙ כַּאֲשֶׁר־ אָבִי֙ שָׂ֤ם בְּשֹׁ֣מְר֔וֹן בַּבְּרִ֣ית וַאֲנִ֖י אֲשַׁלְּחֶ֑ךָּ וַיִּכְרָת־ בְרִ֖ית ל֥וֹ וַֽיְשַׁלְּחֵֽהוּ׃ס
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer ’ê·lāw ’ā·šîḇ he·‘ā·rîm ’ă·šer- ’ā·ḇî lā·qaḥ- mê·’êṯ ’ā·ḇî·ḵā tā·śîm lə·ḵā wə·ḥū·ṣō·wṯ ḇə·ḏam·me·śeq ka·’ă·šer- ’ā·ḇî śām bə·šō·mə·rō·wn bab·bə·rîṯ wa·’ă·nî ’ă·šal·lə·ḥe·kā way·yiḵ·rāṯ- ḇə·rîṯ lōw way·šal·lə·ḥê·hū
verses.literal: Ben-hadad said to him I will restore the cities - my father took from your father you may set up your own marketplaces in Damascus as my father [did] in Samaria By this treaty I release you ,” [Ahab replied] So he made a treaty with him and sent him away

verses.original: בִּדְבַ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה וְאִ֨ישׁ אֶחָ֜ד מִבְּנֵ֣י הַנְּבִיאִ֗ים אָמַ֧ר אֶל־ רֵעֵ֛הוּ הַכֵּ֣ינִי נָ֑א וַיְמָאֵ֥ן הָאִ֖ישׁ לְהַכֹּתֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: biḏ·ḇar Yah·weh wə·’îš ’e·ḥāḏ mib·bə·nê han·nə·ḇî·’îm ’ā·mar ’el- rê·‘ê·hū hak·kê·nî nā way·mā·’ên hā·’îš lə·hak·kō·ṯōw
verses.literal: Meanwhile, by the word of the LORD vvv one of the sons of the prophets said to his companion Strike me please But [the man] refused . . . to strike him

verses.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר ל֗וֹ יַ֚עַן אֲשֶׁ֤ר לֹֽא־ שָׁמַ֙עְתָּ֙ בְּק֣וֹל יְהוָ֔ה הִנְּךָ֤ הוֹלֵךְ֙ מֵֽאִתִּ֔י הָאַרְיֵ֑ה וְהִכְּךָ֖ וַיֵּ֙לֶךְ֙ מֵֽאֶצְל֔וֹ הָאַרְיֵ֖ה וַיִּמְצָאֵ֥הוּ וַיַּכֵּֽהוּ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer lōw ya·‘an ’ă·šer lō- šā·ma‘·tā bə·qō·wl Yah·weh hin·nə·ḵā hō·w·lêḵ mê·’it·tî hā·’ar·yêh wə·hik·kə·ḵā way·yê·leḵ mê·’eṣ·lōw hā·’ar·yêh way·yim·ṣā·’ê·hū way·yak·kê·hū
verses.literal: Then [the prophet] said to him Because - you have not obeyed the voice of the LORD as soon as you depart from me a lion will kill you And when he left . . . a lion found him and killed him

verses.original: וַיִּמְצָא֙ אַחֵ֔ר אִ֣ישׁ וַיֹּ֖אמֶר הַכֵּ֣ינִי נָ֑א הָאִ֖ישׁ וַיַּכֵּ֥הוּ הַכֵּ֥ה וּפָצֹֽעַ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yim·ṣā ’a·ḥêr ’îš way·yō·mer hak·kê·nî nā hā·’îš way·yak·kê·hū hak·kêh ū·p̄ā·ṣō·a‘
verses.literal: Then the prophet found another man and said Strike me please So the man struck him and wounded him . . .

verses.original: הַנָּבִ֔יא וַיֵּ֙לֶךְ֙ וַיַּעֲמֹ֥ד עַל־ הַדָּ֑רֶךְ לַמֶּ֖לֶךְ וַיִּתְחַפֵּ֥שׂ בָּאֲפֵ֖ר עַל־ עֵינָֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: han·nā·ḇî way·yê·leḵ way·ya·‘ă·mōḏ ‘al- had·dā·reḵ lam·me·leḵ way·yiṯ·ḥap·pêś bā·’ă·p̄êr ‘al- ‘ê·nāw
verses.literal: and the prophet went and waited on the road for the king disguising himself with a bandage over his eyes

verses.original: וַיְהִ֤י הַמֶּ֙לֶךְ֙ עֹבֵ֔ר וְה֖וּא צָעַ֣ק אֶל־ הַמֶּ֑לֶךְ וַיֹּ֜אמֶר עַבְדְּךָ֣׀ יָצָ֣א בְקֶֽרֶב־ הַמִּלְחָמָ֗ה וְהִנֵּֽה־ אִ֨ישׁ סָ֜ר וַיָּבֵ֧א אִ֗ישׁ וַיֹּ֙אמֶר֙ אֵלַ֣י שְׁמֹר֙ אֶת־ הַזֶּ֔ה הָאִ֣ישׁ אִם־ יִפָּקֵ֔ד הִפָּקֵד֙ נַפְשְׁךָ֙ וְהָיְתָ֤ה תַּ֣חַת נַפְשׁ֔וֹ א֥וֹ תִּשְׁקֽוֹל׃ כִכַּר־ כֶּ֖סֶף
verses.transliteration: way·hî ham·me·leḵ ‘ō·ḇêr wə·hū ṣā·‘aq ’el- ham·me·leḵ way·yō·mer ‘aḇ·də·ḵā yā·ṣā ḇə·qe·reḇ- ham·mil·ḥā·māh wə·hin·nêh- ’îš sār way·yā·ḇê ’îš way·yō·mer ’ê·lay šə·mōr ’eṯ- haz·zeh hā·’îš ’im- yip·pā·qêḏ hip·pā·qêḏ nap̄·šə·ḵā wə·hā·yə·ṯāh ta·ḥaṯ nap̄·šōw ’ōw tiš·qō·wl ḵik·kar- ke·sep̄
verses.literal: - As the king passed by he cried out to the king - Your servant had marched out into the middle of the battle when suddenly a man came over with a captive and told me Guard - this man If he goes missing for any reason your life will be exchanged for his life or you will weigh out a talent of silver

verses.original: עַבְדְּךָ֗ וַיְהִ֣י עֹשֵׂ֥ה הֵ֛נָּה וָהֵ֖נָּה וְה֣וּא אֵינֶ֑נּוּ מֶֽלֶךְ־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֛ל וַיֹּ֨אמֶר אֵלָ֧יו כֵּ֥ן מִשְׁפָּטֶ֖ךָ חָרָֽצְתָּ׃ אַתָּ֥ה
verses.transliteration: ‘aḇ·də·ḵā way·hî ‘ō·śêh hên·nāh wā·hên·nāh wə·hū ’ê·nen·nū me·leḵ- yiś·rā·’êl way·yō·mer ’ê·lāw kên miš·pā·ṭe·ḵā ḥā·rā·ṣə·tā ’at·tāh
verses.literal: But while your servant was busy here and there [the man] disappeared And the king of Israel said to him So [shall] your judgment [be] you have pronounced it on yourself

verses.original: וַיְמַהֵ֕ר וַיָּ֙סַר֙ אֶת־ הָ֣אֲפֵ֔ר מֵעַל עֵינָ֑יו מֶ֣לֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וַיַּכֵּ֤ר אֹתוֹ֙ כִּ֥י הֽוּא׃ מֵֽהַנְּבִאִ֖ים
verses.transliteration: way·ma·hêr way·yā·sar ’eṯ- hā·’ă·p̄êr mē·ʿal ‘ê·nāw me·leḵ yiś·rā·’êl way·yak·kêr ’ō·ṯōw kî hū mê·han·nə·ḇi·’îm
verses.literal: Then [the prophet] quickly removed - the bandage from his eyes and the king of Israel recognized him as - one of the prophets

verses.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֵלָ֗יו כֹּ֚ה יְהוָ֔ה אָמַ֣ר יַ֛עַן שִׁלַּ֥חְתָּ אֶת־ מִיָּ֑ד אִישׁ־ חֶרְמִ֖י נַפְשְׁךָ֙ וְהָיְתָ֤ה תַּ֣חַת נַפְשׁ֔וֹ וְעַמְּךָ֖ תַּ֥חַת עַמּֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer ’ê·lāw kōh Yah·weh ’ā·mar ya·‘an šil·laḥ·tā ’eṯ- mî·yāḏ ’îš- ḥer·mî nap̄·šə·ḵā wə·hā·yə·ṯāh ta·ḥaṯ nap̄·šōw wə·‘am·mə·ḵā ta·ḥaṯ ‘am·mōw
verses.literal: And [the prophet] said to [the king] This is what the LORD says Because you have let slip - from your hand the man I had devoted to destruction your life will be exchanged for his life and your people for his people

verses.original: סַ֣ר וְזָעֵ֑ף מֶֽלֶךְ־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֛ל וַיֵּ֧לֶךְ עַל־ בֵּית֖וֹ וַיָּבֹ֖א שֹׁמְרֽוֹנָה׃פ
verses.transliteration: sar wə·zā·‘êp̄ me·leḵ- yiś·rā·’êl way·yê·leḵ ‘al- bê·ṯōw way·yā·ḇō šō·mə·rō·w·nāh
verses.literal: Sullen and angry the king of Israel went - home - to Samaria
